description: Get an expiring authenticated download URL for your ready personal data export. Returns downloadUrl and expiresAt, never archive bytes. Open the URL in a browser signed in to the same account, or fetch it with an OAuth token that has stella:account_export_read consent. Poll account-exports.status.get while building; call account-exports.create for an expired or failed export.

exportId.description: Export ID returned by account-exports.create or account-exports.get.
